description.value:
As soon as you could carry a bucket, you were sweeping floors and wiping counters in an artisan's workshop for a few coppers a day. Once old enough to become an apprentice, you learned to make simple crafts of your own and to charm the occasional difficult customer. The trade also taught you to notice the smallest details.

Ability Scores: Strength, Dexterity, Intelligence

Feat: @UUID[Compendium.compendium-owidyn.backgrounds-feats.Item.Kj7f6WGfP8GVfmt1]{Crafter}

Skill Proficiencies: Investigation and Persuasion

Tool Proficiency: Choose one kind of Artisan's Tools

Equipment: Choose A or B: (A) Artisan's Tools (same as above), 2 @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagPouch000000]{Pouches}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagClothesTrav]{Traveler's Clothes}, 32 GP; or (B) 50 GP

nvA5pQ28wZA5TYut.hint: Your background allows you to increase your Strength, Dexterity, and Intelligence scores; increase one of them by 2 and a different one by 1, or increase all three by 1. None of these increases can raise a score above 20.
